text: DEFONEOS — DEFRA Wildlife Crime AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × DEFRA × WILDLIFE CRIME DEFRA Wildlife Crime AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK DEFRA wildlife crime — NWCU operations, CITES enforcement, raptor persecution, poaching, badger crime, bat protection, marine wildlife, online trade. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points NWCU NWCU Operations — Intelligence Hub, Case Coordination National Wildlife Crime Unit — UK's dedicated wildlife crime intelligence hub. Priority species: badgers, bats, raptors, reptiles, marine mammals, CITES-listed species. Case coordination across 43 police forces. Intelligence assessment, analytical products, tactical advice. Liaison with CPS wildlife crime unit. Annual wildlife crime threat assessment. Funding via DEFRA, Home Office, Scottish Government. Operational command structure. Joint investigations with NCA, Border Force. CITES CITES Enforcement — Permits, Border Force Detection Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species — UK CITES Management Authority (DEFRA). Import/export permits for Appendix I, II, III species. Border Force CITES team — ports, airports, postal hubs. TRAFFIC monitoring — wildlife trade network. Seizure data — ivory, reptile skins, live birds, traditional medicines. Penalty regime: up to 7 years under Control of Trade in Endangered Species (COTES) 2024. Scientific Authority (Natural England). Re-export certificates. Personal ownership exemptions. Raptor Raptor Persecution — Satellite Tagging, Hen Harrier Raptor persecution — UK's most serious wildlife crime category. Hen harrier — red-listed, driven to extinction on English grouse moors. Satellite tagging — Natural England, RSPB, BTO. Nest monitoring, GPS tracking, suspicious disappearance analysis. Game estate proximity mapping. Poisoning — carbofuran, alphachloralose, bendiocarb. Trapping — spring traps, pole traps, gin traps. Nest destruction. National Raptor Crime Database. Operation Owl — police raptor initiative. Vicarious liability (Scotland). Poaching Poaching — Deer, Fish, Hare Coursing Wildlife poaching — deer (roe, fallow, red), fish (salmon, trout, eels), hare coursing. Deer poaching: night shooting, dogs, vehicles. Fish poaching: illegal nets, rod licence fraud, salmon egg theft. Hare coursing: organised crime, gambling, dogs (lurchers, greyhounds). Rural crime teams — NFU, CLA, police. Poaching priority areas — Operation Galileo (deer). National Wildlife Crime Intelligence Report. Seasonal patterns — autumn deer, spring salmon. Damage to agriculture and fisheries. Badger Badger Crime — Baiting, Sett Disturbance Badger crime — protected under Protection of Badgers Act 1992. Badger baiting — dogs, digging, organised cruelty. Sett disturbance — development, forestry, agricultural operations. TB culling interaction — licensed culling in England, interaction with badger crime enforcement. Sett survey requirements. Badger persecution intelligence — NWCU priority. Prosecution challenges — evidence, location, identification. Badger vaccination programmes. Artificial sett construction. Licensing for development (Natural England). Bat Bat Protection — Roost Disturbance, Development Licensing Bat protection — all 17 UK species protected under Conservation of Habitats Regulations 2017. Roost disturbance — building demolition, barn conversions, tree felling. Development licensing — European Protected Species (EPS) mitigation licences. Bat surveys — emergence, activity, DNA (droppings). Bat boxes, bat lofts, roost compensation. Licensed bat workers. Bat Crime Hotline — Bat Conservation Trust. Hibernation site protection. Light pollution impact. Wind turbine interaction. Marine Marine Wildlife — Seal Disturbance, Cetacean Bycatch Marine wildlife crime —
